subject: general
question: Pradhan Mantri Urja Ganga project of Eastern India is related to:

options.text: Electricity transmission line for eastern India
Ganga cleaning project for Eastern India

solution:
The correct answer is __**Natural gas pipeline**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Pradhan Mantri Urja Ganga project aims to provide piped cooking gas to residents in eastern India, ensuring a cleaner and more efficient energy source.
 
• This project involves laying a 2,655 km long gas pipeline, extending from Jagdishpur in Uttar Pradesh to Haldia in West Bengal, covering various states like Bihar, Jharkhand, and Odisha.
 
• The project is expected to benefit millions of households and industries by providing an uninterrupted supply of natural gas.
 
• It also aims to establish Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) stations in cities along the pipeline route to promote the use of CNG in transportation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Natural Gas**

 
 
• Natural gas is a fossil fuel composed primarily of methane, used for heating, electricity generation, and as fuel for vehicles.
 
• It is considered a cleaner alternative to other fossil fuels like coal and oil because it produces fewer pollutants and greenhouse gases.
 
• Natural gas can be transported in liquid form (LNG) or through pipelines in its gaseous state.
 
• India's focus on expanding its natural gas infrastructure is part of its broader energy strategy to enhance energy security and reduce environmental impact.
 
 
 
• **Piped Natural Gas (PNG)**
 
 
• Piped Natural Gas is delivered to homes and industries through a network of pipelines, making it convenient and reliable.
 
• PNG is used for cooking in homes, as well as for heating and cooling in industries.
 
• It is safer than traditional LPG cylinders as it is lighter than air and disperses quickly in case of a leak.
 
• PNG connections are being rapidly expanded in urban and semi-urban areas to provide cleaner energy options.
 
 
 
• **Compressed Natural Gas (CNG)**
 
 
• Compressed Natural Gas is natural gas under high pressure, used as a fuel alternative to gasoline, diesel, and propane.
 
• CNG is considered more environmentally friendly as it produces fewer emissions of pollutants and greenhouse gases.
 
• It is used primarily in vehicles, including cars, buses, and trucks, to reduce air pollution.
 
• The expansion of CNG stations along major routes is part of India's strategy to encourage the adoption of cleaner fuels in transportation.
